title: Saquon Barkley returns, but Titans tie it 17-17 with Cam Ward's second rushing TD

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Saquon Barkley returns, but Titans tie it 17-17 with Cam Ward's second rushing TD
sources.description: Titans quarterback Cam Ward has two rushing touchdowns today against the Eagles, and the game is tied 17-17 at the start of the fourth quarter.
